tagline: Calm, bright desk explainers: every app, book or idea you name drops in as a polished card above your head, with soft word-by-word captions and red hand-drawn circles.
readiness_note: Best with a screenshot or screen recording of each tool you name; without them Claude builds clean labelled mock-ups. The story format needs your own B-roll.
